CheckTitle: DCS Redis instances require password authentication
Description: Ensure that DCS Redis instances require password authentication.
Risk: Redis instances without password authentication allow any client in the VPC to connect, increasing the risk of unauthorized access and data exfiltration.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Distributed Cache Service.
3. Select the instance.
4. Enable password authentication for the instance.

Recommendation.Text: Enable password authentication for DCS Redis instances.

Notes: Checks if DCS Redis instances allow access without password (no_password_access is true).
